definitions.explanation: A person who travels to unknown or unfamiliar places to investigate or discover.

examples.japanese: ⟦{偉大|いだい}→偉大：01798_idai⟧な{探検者|たんけんしゃ}たち。
{子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}、{探検者|たんけんしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{憧|あこが}れていた→憧れる：05302_akogareru⟧。
examples.english: When I was a child, I admired explorers.

examples.japanese: {十五世紀|じゅうごせいき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ヨーロッパ→ヨーロッパ：00427_yooroppa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{探検者|たんけんしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{未知|みち}→未知：13014_michi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大陸|たいりく}→大陸：03400_tairiku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}して→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧⟦{航海|こうかい}→航海：02797_koukai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: In fifteenth-century Europe, many explorers set out on voyages to reach unknown continents.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{探検|たんけん}→探検：17461_tanken⟧ (exploration, expedition) and the agent suffix ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). Refers to someone who explores unknown regions, whether historically (geographical explorers) or in modern contexts (cave explorers, deep-sea explorers, etc.).

Note: ⟦{探検|たんけん}→探検：17461_tanken⟧ can also be written {探険|たんけん} (with {険|けん} meaning "danger" rather than {検|けん} meaning "examine"). Both spellings are accepted, though ⟦{探検|たんけん}→探検：17461_tanken⟧ is more standard.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{偉大|いだい}→偉大：01798_idai⟧な{探検者|たんけんしゃ}: a great explorer
- ⟦{北極|ほっきょく}→北極：16689_hokkyoku⟧{探検者|たんけんしゃ}: Arctic explorer
- {探検者|たんけんしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧: records of an explorer
- {探検者|たんけんしゃ}⟦{精神|せいしん}→精神：03377_seishin⟧: explorer's spirit

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{冒険家|ぼうけんか}→冒険家：20564_boukenka⟧: adventurer — emphasizes risk-taking and daring, often used for modern adventurers
- ⟦{探検家|たんけんか}→探検家：27953_tankenka⟧: explorer — synonym using the suffix ⟦{家|か}→〜家：28339_ka⟧ instead of ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧; slightly more prestigious
- ⟦{旅人|たびびと}→旅人：12725_tabibito⟧: traveler — more poetic, doesn't imply discovery or investigation
